title: Memory
description: Each agent gets its own memory by default. Multiple agents can share a memory.
name: Space name
emptyDescription: Bind a space to extract reusable experience when an issue reaches Done.
notConfigured: The knowledge service is not configured.
memberWait: Ask a workspace owner or admin to bind a knowledge space.
confirmUnbind: Detach this knowledge space? Existing knowledge stays in the space. Pending extraction jobs will be removed.
noExtractions: Completed issues will appear here when extraction starts.
memoryDescription: Each agent gets its own memory by default. Multiple agents can share a memory.
memoryDetached: No memory is bound. Extraction and recall are paused.
changeMemoryDescription: Choose a memory. Memories already used by other agents can be shared.
detachMemoryDescription: Detach this memory? Its content will remain, and this agent will stop extraction and recall.
deleteMemoryDescription: Permanently delete “{{name}}” and its chat memory? All agents using it will be detached. Independent Skill, Wiki and CodeGraph assets remain managed in the native panel.
deleteBoundMemory: Also permanently delete the bound memory, if any
keepMemoryDescription: Leave unchecked to keep memory content. Shared memory must be retained while other agents use it.
